web.why: The law only grants or withholds a power: a state's permission for its localities to levy an income tax (Tax Foundation, Local Income Taxes: A Primer, 2023, Tables 1-4). By its terms it moves no place outcome of its own. What a locality does with the power is the income tax its council then enacts, and that rate's outcome links (income-tax-rate-to-poverty and income-tax-rate-to-out-migration in data/research/outcome-web/links.json, both researched at about zero) are the income-tax law's own.
